comment.text: HSD11B1 G45 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Breast carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting HSD11B1 residue G45 have been observed in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and breast carcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

report_comment.text: The HSD11B1 G45R alteration has been observed in cutaneous melanoma and lung adenocarcinoma. Its functional and clinical significance require allele- and tumor-specific assessment.
